data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Nivin means 'gift' or 'grace'. This beautiful name is derived from the root 'nawwana' which signifies giving. In Islamic tradition, Nivin is a reminder of the blessings and gifts bestowed upon us by Allah. The name Nivin carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nivin usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nivin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
